has_own_site_evidence: Google Business Profile's 'Website:' button points only to a Facebook page (facebook.com/MikesProDetailingTampa), which does not count as an own domain per pipeline rules. A WebSearch for the business name plus 'email contact' surfaced a separate page at mikes-pro-detailing.pages.dev with a full nav, a services menu with specific prices and a copyright notice. This was checked carefully: it is NOT linked from the business's own Google Business Profile, Facebook page, or any verified first-party channel; it reads exactly like the same speculative, templated pattern found for two other Tampa detailing candidates researched in this same session (auto-detailing-2vk.pages.dev for Tropik Detailing, preview-the-j-b-mobile-detailing.pages.dev for J&B Mobile Detailing), both of which were confirmed to be third-party/unofficial pages, not sites the businesses built or maintain themselves. Per the pipeline's own authoritative source (Google Business Profile shows no website field), has_own_site = false. The pricing and email found on that page are treated as unverified third-party content below, not used as confirmed site data.

Site uses the adapted variant: every detail is quoted, call for a price, nothing invented from an unverified source.

reviews_verbatim.name: Cameron
reviews_verbatim.text: Good people did a quality job at an honest price. They do all the work themselves but I didn't mind waiting at the business for them to finish up...

reviews_verbatim.name: Pritam Kanchan
reviews_verbatim.text: I had given my car for paint spots removal and internal and external detailing. The owner Mike was very confident that he will remove all spots and car will look new inside out. He is a sweet talker...

reviews_verbatim.name: Elena Vorobei
reviews_verbatim.text: We really appreciate Mike's Pro detailing for cleaning of our car! Thank you for the hospitality and great job! It smells and looks like new now!

reviews_note: 3 real verbatim Google reviews (2 truncated at Google's own preview length), collected via scripts/maps_research.py. Owner name 'Mike' confirmed both by the Pritam Kanchan review and the storefront sign photo.
